inputs.name: prop
inputs.meaning: teacher_prop: base_lin_vel 3 (privileged) | base_ang_vel 3 | projected_gravity 3 | joint_pos - default 12 | joint_vel 12 | last raw action clipped to +-50 12 | goal [x, y, sin, cos] 4; body frame, scale 1, no clip apart from the last action

inputs.name: mapping
inputs.meaning: teacher_mapping: ground-truth height map, cell [i, j] = (x_i, y_j, z_ij) in the yaw-aligned base frame; i = x index (outer, 29, -0.42..1.26 m), j = y index (inner, 13, -0.36..0.36 m); z = hit z - base z + 0.27 clipped to [-1.5, 1.5]

outputs.name: action
outputs.meaning: a: deterministic mean of the actor (raw, before scale and offset), Isaac joint order

outputs.name: gaze_r
outputs.meaning: diagnostic: gaze location r = sigmoid(gaze logits) in (0,1)^2; crop corner ox = clamp(round(r0 * 17), 0, 17), oy = clamp(round(r1 * 3), 0, 3) (12 x 10 window of the 29 x 13 map)

actor_input_order.frame: base (root COM velocity in the base frame)

actor_input_order.formula: clip(a_prev, -50, 50), a_prev = previous ONNX action (raw), 0 after a reset

map_input_order: second input 'mapping' (agent obs_groups.actor = [teacher_mapping, teacher_prop]; the ONNX takes them by name)

command.frame: goal position relative to the base, rotated by the base yaw only (x forward, y left)
command.far_goal_rule: if |(x, y)| > 2.0 m: (x, y) scaled to norm 2.0 and e replaced by U(-pi, pi), drawn again every control step

action.formula: target_q = default_joint_pos + 0.25 * action (Isaac order); target velocity 0; feed-forward torque 0
outside_onnx: keep a_prev = action (raw) for the next prop[33:45] = clip(a_prev, -50, 50)
action.last_action_obs: raw action before scale / offset / delay, clipped to +-50

motor_model.pd: tau = kp * (target_q - q) + kd * (0 - dq), evaluated every physics step (200 Hz)
motor_model.clip: driving (tau * dq > 0): plateau y1, braking: plateau y2; limit = plateau * clamp((x2 - |dq|) / (x2 - x1), 0, 1); tau = clamp(tau, -limit, limit)

action_delay.sampled: once per episode at reset, per robot
action_delay.applied: FIFO over physics steps (4 per control step)

map.alignment: yaw (rays vertical, grid rotated by base yaw only)
map.ray_start: 20 m above the base, cast straight down (max distance 1e6 m)
map.z_definition: z = hit_z_world - base_z_world + 0.27, then clipped to [-1.5, 1.5] (clip after void filling)
map.no_return_rule_training: virtual floor: on sparse tiles with voids (here: stones) the cell reads max(terrain, plane at world z = d), d ~ U(-1.0, -0.4) per episode; any other ray without a return reads (lowest valid height of the same scan) - |d| (0.4..1.0 m below), or the plane height if no ray of the scan returns

network.global_context: Conv(3->8,k3) ELU Conv(8->32,k3,dil2) ELU -> spatial max -> Linear 32-64 ELU (whole 29x13 map, x/y channels included)
network.gaze: Linear(192-64) ELU Linear(64-2) -> sigmoid -> integer 12x10 crop (round, clamp)
network.crop_encoder: per cell Linear(3-16) ELU | Conv(z: 1->8,k5,p2) ELU Conv(8->48,k5,p2) ELU | concat 64 -> Linear 96 ELU -> 120 tokens

excluded: critic (MoE 16 experts, obs group critic incl. time_left and height_scanner_critic)
training noise of teacher_prop and teacher_mapping
